_published_faq.name: How do I add Uber Eats to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Uber Eats to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ubereats.com/eats-claude/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Uber Eats MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Uber Eats scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Uber Eats MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uber Eats provides these MCP tools: search and publish_analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Uber Eats?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Uber Eats in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Uber Eats MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uber Eats does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Uber Eats failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uber Eats scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Uber Eats is developed by Uber. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
